title: Settings
closeBehaviorDescription: Quit the app, or keep it running in the system tray.
closeDesktopOnly: This setting is only available in the desktop app.
closeSettingsError: Unable to read or save close settings. Please retry.
closePromptDescription: Choose what happens when this window closes.
closeBackgroundHint: Keep receiving mail. Reopen from the system tray.
closeQuitHint: Exit completely and stop background syncing.
closeBackgroundUnavailable: A recoverable system tray is not available on this platform. Background mode is unavailable.
closeRemember: Remember my choice and do not ask again
closeRememberHint: Change this any time in General settings.
closeResolveError: The action did not finish. The window remains open. Retry, or uncheck “Remember my choice” to apply it only this time.
description: Choose a category on the left to view and adjust its settings.
accountsDescription: Manage connected email accounts, review connection and sync status, or add an account.
accountsUnavailable: The desktop mail service is not connected.
notificationsDescription: Review support for new mail notifications.
notificationsUnavailable: System notifications, sounds and Do Not Disturb settings are not connected in this version. Desktop new mail notifications are not sent.
aiDescription: Review support for AI-assisted mail features.
aiUnavailable: General AI analysis, model and API key configuration are not connected. Email translation uses a third-party service only after permission and a manual request.
translationAvailable: Email translation is available in the reading toolbar for the subject and body, with target language selection and automatic source detection. Only permitted text is sent, never attachments or login credentials.
updatesDescription: View the installed version and update capabilities.
updatesUnavailable: Update services are not connected in this version. Checking for or automatically installing updates is unavailable. This does not mean your version is up to date.
imagesNotSaved: The preference could not be saved. It applies for this session but may reset after restarting.
mailImagesHint: Changes apply immediately and are saved locally. Remote images may disclose your IP address and reading activity to the sender. Only embedded images are displayed by default.
storageDescription: See how the local data directory is used, grouped by storage type.
storageMailDataDescription: SQLite database, search index and WAL / SHM files
storageLogsDescription: Application logs in the local data directory
storageOtherDescription: Other local files in the data directory
storageNote: Actual file sizes in the current app data directory, not total disk capacity. The search index is included in mail data. Sizes may change during sync and log writes.
storageError: Unable to read local storage usage. Please retry in the desktop app.
storageEmpty: The current data directory is empty.
versionUnavailable: Version information is unavailable. Check the desktop connection in the workspace.
languageDescription: Choose the language used in the interface.
appearanceDescription: Choose light, dark, or automatically match your system.
appearanceNotSaved: The appearance preference could not be saved. It applies for this session but may reset after restarting.
mailFollowsDarkModeHint: When enabled, HTML email bodies adapt to the app's dark mode. Turn off to keep the original message colors. Changes apply immediately, are saved locally, and do not affect image settings.
mailAppearanceNotSaved: The preference could not be saved. It applies for this session but may reset after restarting.
